Working, once I added connection details to Heroku:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/156783534-d9b76efb-8885-4135-b081-f1fe6c48ac78.png)

Hello @lilitkarapetyan - there is an outstanding issue here.  For lots of wargames, `cloudant` won't be available.

So, i _think_ we do want Heroku instances to always use `cloudant`.  But, for others (including running Serge locally), it should still start with a local `sqlite` database.  

I _think_ we could check for connection strings at startup.  If they're present, try to use them to connect to cloudant, else run a SQLite connection.

How does this sound?
